existing_group_assignments.rationale: Stabilization of the PPAR alpha co-repressor concerns PPARα signaling, a distinct process on the same receptor as binding, activation and transactivation.
Increase in cell injury/death is the same direction of cell death, with differing specificity from necrosis and CNS neural cell death.
Decrease in population growth rate is a population-level decline endpoint that differs in specificity from population size and trajectory.
Decreased fertility is the same endpoint as the decreased fertility in the group, though less specific.
Decreased mitochondrial ATP production is the same decreased-ATP process as the group members, with a mitochondrial context qualifier.
Increase in inflammation, same process as the general and tissue-specific inflammation events in the group.
Altered larval development is the same developmental process as the impaired larval/general development events.
Triglyceride accumulation is the same increased-triglyceride endpoint as the group members.
Inhibition of PPAR alpha concerns the same receptor as the other PPARalpha binding/activity/activation events but is a distinct process.
Inhibition of mitochondrial fatty acid beta-oxidation is the same endpoint as Decrease, Fatty acid beta-oxidation.
Increase in LH, with differing context specificity relative to the anterior pituitary secretion event.
Collagen accumulation is a cellular process contributing to fibrosis, so it is flagged as a context difference from organ-level fibrosis.
Increase, Liver fibrosis is the same process (fibrosis) as the existing group members, in a liver context.
Reduced prostaglandins in ovary is a less specific form of reduced prostaglandin F2alpha synthesis in ovary, so it differs in specificity rather than being a synonym.
Reduced reproductive success is the same endpoint as Decreased, Reproductive Success and is opposite to Increased, Reproductive Success.
Decreased GnRH pulsatility/release describes the same decrease as the group members, with differing specificity.
Decreased LH Surge is the same event as the decreased LH surge from the anterior pituitary.
Inhibition of the ERG voltage-gated potassium channel concerns the same channel as hERG blockade and IKr inhibition, but it is a distinct functional description that needs curator review.
Reduced hypothalamic GnRH is the same decreased-GnRH process, with different wording and specificity from the existing GnRH release events.
Reduced plasma LH is the same decreased-LH process as the LH surge and release events, but it lacks the anterior pituitary or surge context.
Increased LH is the same direction and endpoint as the existing 'Increased, Leutinizing hormone (LH)' (spelling variant), alongside the pituitary-specific form.
Increased endometrial adenocarcinomas is the same tumor process in a different tissue context.
Increased papillomas/carcinomas in squamous cells is a tumor increase in a distinct tissue context.
Necrosis in terminal bronchiolar cells is a cell-injury/cytotoxicity event in a specific cell context, comparable to club-cell cytotoxicity.
Decreased aromatase mRNA is a reduction in aromatase expression, related to general aromatase inhibition but with a different specificity.
Not applicable
Increase in mutations in critical genes is the same process as 'Increased, Induced Mutations in Critical Genes' and is a gene-specific form of increased mutations.
Decreased T3 is the same endpoint as decreased T3 in tissues, with less specified context.
Leukocyte recruitment/activation is not the same as inflammation, so this match is not clear.
Increased PPAR-alpha activation concerns the same receptor as 'Activation, PPARα' and the other PPARα events, so curators should review it with them.
Increased cholestasis is the same pathology as 'Cholestasis, Pathology' and is closely related to bile accumulation.
Decreased ovarian E2 is reduced estradiol in a specific tissue context, like the other estradiol reduction events.
Hyperplasia of acinar cells is the same process in a different cell context.
Lactotroph hyperplasia is the same process in a different cell context.
Ovarian stromal cell hyperplasia is the same process in a different cell context.
Ovarian epithelium hyperplasia is the same process in a different tissue context.
Smooth muscle hypertrophy/hyperplasia is the same process in a different tissue context.
Pituitary adenomas are increased adenomas in a different tissue context.
Ovarian adenomas are increased adenomas in a different tissue context.
Persistent cytotoxicity in pleura or peritoneum is cytotoxicity in a different tissue context.
Increased proliferation of mesenchymal cells is cell proliferation in a specific cell context.
Smooth muscle proliferation/clonal expansion is cell proliferation in a specific cell context.
Increased cell proliferation specified for epithelial cells, versus the general and mesothelium-specific forms already in the group.
Increased ductal hyperplasia is the same process as the other increased-hyperplasia events, in a different tissue context.
Increased general DNA damage is the same process as increased DNA strand breaks, which are a more specific form of DNA damage.
Decreased sodium conductance 2 concerns the same sodium channel conductance endpoint as 'Decreased, Sodium conductance 1'.
Necrosis (general) is the same process as 'Increase, Necrosis' and belongs with the cell death/necrosis context group.
Binding to voltage-gated sodium channel shares the sodium channel object with inhibition/modulation events but is a distinct process.
Lipid peroxidation is the same process as 'Increase, Lipid peroxidation' and the membrane-lipid oxidation event, differing only in specificity.
Persistent/sustained proliferation matches 'Induction, Sustained Cell Proliferation' in the existing group.
Liver cancer is a liver tumor endpoint, related to the hepatocellular carcinoma and liver tumor events with differing specificity.
Increased follicular atresia is an increase in loss of the follicle/oocyte pool, like increased oocyte atresia, with differing specificity.
Decreased locomotor activity is the same endpoint as 'Decreased, locomotion', in the opposite direction to 'Increased, locomotion'.
Protein adduct formation concerns the same protein object as alkylation and covalent binding, but is described differently.
Increase in chromosomal aberrations matches the existing 'Increase Chromosomal Aberrations' event, so it is a wording variant that fits the same group.
Stellate cell activation is not a clear fit for the retinoic acid group, so it should not be assigned.
Population trajectory decline is the same population-level decline concept as 'Decreased, Population trajectory' and size.
Impaired ovulation is the same endpoint as decreased or delayed ovulation, with differing wording.
placeholder
Decreased mitochondrial fatty acid beta oxidation is the same direction and endpoint as decreased fatty acid beta-oxidation, though it adds a mitochondrial qualifier.
Decrease in triglyceride is the same endpoint as the increased triglyceride events but in the opposite direction, so it is flagged for curator review.
Increased oocyte apoptosis (F3) is the same process (apoptosis) in the F3 generation context.
ER stress is a related cellular stress, but this is too loose to include.
Cytochrome oxidase is mitochondrial complex IV; inhibition of it matches the existing complex IV inhibition/binding group.
Generic increased cell proliferation, same process as the general member of this context group.
Decreased photosystem II efficiency concerns the same photosystem II object as the existing group members.
placeholder
Induced Ang II accumulation describes increased angiotensin II, matching the existing increased Ang II events.
Mitochondrial dysfunction (placeholder title) is the same process as the general mitochondrial dysfunction event, differing in specificity.
Not clearly justified
Pulmonary inflammation is the same process as the general and liver-specific inflammation events, in a different organ context.
Disruption of sodium channel gating kinetics concerns the same sodium channel object as inhibition, modulation and reduced conductance, but is a distinct process.
Inhibition of the mitochondrial electron transport chain complexes is the same kind of event as the existing 'electron transport chain, disrupted' entry, differing in specificity.
Decreased GLI1/2 target gene expression is part of the same Hedgehog pathway signaling cascade, but only weakly linked; omitted.
Increase in pro-inflammatory mediators is the same event as the group's increased pro-inflammatory mediators, differing only in wording.
Disruption of the estrogen receptor concerns the same receptor object as agonism/antagonism, but it is not a clear directional opposite, so it is only a weak candidate.
Estrogen receptor alpha inactivation is the opposite direction of the ER activation events and concerns the same receptor.
Increased pro-inflammatory cytokine expression is a closely related increase in pro-inflammatory mediators, differing in specificity (cytokines).
Dysregulation of transcriptional expression within the PPAR signaling network concerns PPAR signaling, which the group's PPAR binding, activation and disrupted-signaling events also address.
Mitochondrial Complex I inhibition is the same object and endpoint as the existing complex I inhibition event, and it is flagged alongside the inhibitor-binding event for curator review.
Binding of plastoquinone B within the D1 protein of Photosystem II shares the Photosystem II object but is a distinct process from inhibition or reduced electron transport.
Cardiac fibrosis is the same process (fibrosis) in a different organ context than liver and pulmonary fibrosis.
Increased androgen receptor activation is the same receptor activity process as the decreased AR activation event, so it is flagged for context and direction review.
Increase, Lipid degradation is closely tied to fatty acid beta-oxidation, but this is only loosely related; not clearly the same endpoint.
AhR activation is the same process as the general 'Activation, AhR' member, with only wording differences, so it belongs with the existing AhR activation group.
Cognitive decline is the same endpoint as 'Cognitive function, decreased' in this group.
Kidney fibrosis is the same process (fibrosis) in a different organ from liver and lung fibrosis.
This is a decrease in the transcriptional activity of glucocorticoid receptor, not PPARalpha, so it should not be assigned here.

new_groups.rationale: Increased reactive oxygen species and peptide oxidation are not synonyms, but both are oxidative events at different levels of specificity.
Thyroperoxidase inhibition and decreased thyroid hormone synthesis relate to the thyroid hormone synthesis pathway but are distinct objects and processes, flagged for curator review.
Both are KER-style titles about decreased fetal Leydig testosterone linked to glucocorticoid or corticosterone increase or activation.
Both are KER-style titles about decreased fetal Leydig testosterone linked to increased estradiol or estradiol agonist activation.
These titles share the 'Decreased Cholesterol' upstream event and differ in the pathway step that is decreased.
All are KER-style titles with decreased steroidogenesis in adult Leydig cells.
Both describe repressed or decreased expression of steroidogenic enzymes or proteins.
Both concern alpha2u-globulin, but chemical binding in serum and accumulation in proximal tubular epithelium are distinct processes.
Both concern HIF-1 (heterodimer level vs alpha transcription), distinct processes for the same object.
Both concern pyruvate dehydrogenase regulation (PDH induction vs inhibition of its kinase PDK), distinct processes.
Both concern NE receptors, with binding of NE decreased vs antagonism of the receptor.
Not applicable
Both are porphyrin-related, but they are different molecules, so this grouping is not justified.
Reduced swim bladder inflation, specified for the posterior versus the anterior chamber.
Induced muscle paralysis in different muscle types (somatic versus pharyngeal).
Increased or promoted tumor formation in different tissues and cell types.
Collagen deposition is a cellular/ECM process while lung fibrosis is the organ-level outcome; flagged for curator review.
MLL translocation and infant leukaemia are related but distinct; low confidence, omitted if unjustified.
Both describe increased DNA damage, with oxidative DNA damage being a more specific form than general DNA damage and mutation.
Both concern STAT5: blocked phosphorylation versus suppressed promoter binding are distinct processes.
Inhibition of chitinase and chitobiase are similar chitin-degrading enzyme inhibition events on different enzymes.
Urothelial events are related, but this grouping is weak.
PI3K and AKT activation are different molecules in the same pathway, so only a curator-review grouping is possible; omitted if not justified.
Both are expression changes of inner-ear development genes (six1b increased vs eya1 inhibited); related but different genes, flagged for review.
Reduced Ang II degradation and diminished Ang(1-7) concern the same angiotensin pathway but are distinct processes.
Both concern the folate transporter and its function, but an affected transporter and decreased folate uptake are distinct events.
Both describe increased adipose tissue expansion at the adipocyte level (size vs number).
Both concern glutathione but depletion and conjugation are distinct processes.
Both concern apoptosis regulator expression, but they involve different proteins, so they are only grouped for curator review.
Prostatic intraepithelial neoplasia and prostate cancer are neoplastic outcomes in the same organ with differing specificity.
Both concern gluten-reactive/TG2-reactive B cells (activation vs. B cell receptor generation), which are distinct processes for the same cell object.
Both concern gluten-reactive T cells (activation vs. T cell receptor generation), which are distinct processes for the same cell object.
This is a weak grouping: both concern the INSIG1-SREBP2 regulatory axis, but they are different proteins, so it is flagged only for review.
Both describe altered or delayed cardiac electrical conduction, with differing specificity.
Both describe decreased 11β-HSD activity, but for different isoforms (type 1 reductase vs type 2), so they are flagged for curator review.
